headline: We checked the Claude plugins a viral post says to install
dek: An Instagram carousel listed 30 of the most-starred Claude plugins and skills. The star counts are right. Five things the slides leave out matter more.

blocks.p: A carousel posted on 15 Nov lists 30 Claude plugins and skills, ranked by GitHub stars, in five "teams" of six. We compared every star count with GitHub on 19 Nov. Each was within about 5% of GitHub's own figure.
Stars measure attention, not fit or safety. So we read the GitHub pages of the plugins. Five things stand out.

ol: **GSD is archived.** The get-shit-done repository is read-only on GitHub [S1]. Its last code push was on 31 May 2026 [S1]. An archived project gets no fixes.

**Claude-Mem sends usage analytics unless you turn them off.** Its README says anonymous usage analytics are on by default, and `npx claude-mem telemetry disable` turns them off [S2]. Its hooks hand each tool call your agent makes to a local worker [S2].
**Headroom does the same.** Its README says an anonymous beacon is on by default [S3]. Setting `HEADROOM_TELEMETRY=off` turns it off [S3].
**ECC installs hooks into your global setup.** Its README walks you through choosing "Global user" and "Standard" hooks [S4]. Hooks run on your machine every time they fire.

**REA warns about copies of itself.** REA was created on 14 Apr 2026 and had 468,809 stars on 19 Nov [S5]. Its README says a similar name "does not establish that a download is official" [S6]. Install it only from the links the project itself gives.

blocks.p: One more: **Karpathy Skills has no licence** on GitHub [S7]. Without a licence, nobody may legally reuse its text.
None of this makes a plugin bad. Telemetry that is disclosed and easy to switch off is common. But you should know before you install, not after.

blocks.h: Five checks before you install any plugin

ul: Does it send telemetry by default, and how do you turn it off?
Does it add hooks, and where?
Are you on the official page, or a copy?
